dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I just toss the coin *coughs* into the pool just like this, and *coughs* make a wish...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: You must be *coughs* sincere and do it every day for the fountain fairy to hear you... *coughs*

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... I can't stop coughing...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Oh... I've been *coughs* unwell for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I wish that *coughs* the fountain fairy could help me *coughs* get better.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: So I can stop *coughs* being a burden to my parents and my *coughs* brother Anthony.
